scope: Original WP14 acceptance: real historical-input replay of baseline/candidate with independent quality acceptance — shadow, sealed prospective holdout, same-budget comparison, finite canary and automatic promotion, with the independent-verification, gain and regression gates passing simultaneously on a real TraeX chain. Stronger physical-isolation and multi-family breadth remain follow-up and are recorded as limits, not re-derived into this verdict.

keyImplementations: plugins/assistant-skills/src/comparison.ts — deterministic same-budget baseline/candidate replay and the three promotion gates

plugins/assistant-skills/src/holdout-qualification.ts:206 — attested-after-freeze is derived only when the receipt is complete and candidateChecksPassed && evaluationGain > 0 && criticalRegressionsPassed all hold, otherwise it falls back to unproven

run.result: 1 passed (6.1m) — real TraeX autonomously improves one workflow twice and delivers the bounded result

criteria.requirement: Real replay of historical inputs for both baseline and candidate (no supplied repaired source)
criteria.basis: proof.initialArtifact is a shared unfinished scaffold; proof.suppliedRepairedSource=false; both rounds replay the same historical task through deterministic native-file-tool repair; proof.completedRestartNoReplay=true

criteria.requirement: Independent quality acceptance: shadow comparison with no external side effects
criteria.basis: comparison receipt complete with modelCalls:0 during comparison; candidate generation used only native file tools (toolNames per round: read, write, read); replay runs under network none/read-only/cap-drop/private-root container boundaries with the pinned authority image (DSH_HOLDOUT_TEST_IMAGE sha256 pin enforced by the spec); negative double-container coverage proves no dataset/key/socket mount

criteria.requirement: Sealed prospective holdout bound after freeze
criteria.basis: both rounds record heldoutIndependence='attested-after-freeze' with distinct frozen dataset digests (10fa202c…/772013c…); attestation means the freeze binding precedes CSPRNG generation of the private fixed-semantics cells, generator and dataset digests are signed, and the pinned-key authority releases answers cell-by-cell — deterministic replay cannot pre-read answers

each round quality.evaluationGain=1 with evaluationGainObserved=true under identical bounded budgets (maxModelCalls 32 / maxToolCalls 64 control envelope); total chain usage model_calls=8, tool_calls=6
quality.criticalRegressionsPassed=true and candidateChecksPassed=true in both rounds

each promoted deployment went through state 'canary' with canaryRuns=1/maxRuns=2 before promotion; promotion sessions and timestamps are recorded per round (promotedAt 1789306649887, 1789306777284); five owner feedback receipts (finite-canary/iteration-success x2 plus final-success) were accepted and idempotent

criteria.requirement: All three gates (independent verification, gain, regression) pass together; failure never promotes and falls back to unproven
criteria.basis: the observed chain promoted with all three gates true; the negative branch is unit-covered: holdout-qualification.spec.ts:105 asserts candidateChecksPassed=false/evaluationGain=-1/evaluationGainObserved=false/criticalRegressionsPassed=false derives heldoutIndependence='unproven'; comparison.spec.ts:25 and holdout-cli.spec.ts:272 pin promotionAuthorized=false with unproven independence; holdout-qualification.ts:206 is the single conjunctive derivation

independentReview.basis: Adversarial re-check against the original WP14 clause verified the real TraeX rerun artifacts, the attested-after-freeze derivation on both rounds, the same-budget positive gain, the critical regression gate, finite-canary-before-promotion ordering, idempotent owner feedback, and the unit-covered unproven fallback on three-gate failure (10 checks total).
nonBlockingLow: service.ts hard-gate error string lacks a literal unit test
no mid-repair cold-start restart proof on this chain (completedRestartNoReplay covers restart-after-completion)
TraeX exposes only call-count budgets; token/monetary cost is not observable, and the proven task domain covers two task families

limits: attested-after-freeze certifies only that the freeze binding preceded fixed-semantics CSPRNG cell generation, with signed generator/dataset digests and pinned-key per-cell answer release; it does not attest an independent process, that Docker flags were actually enforced by the kernel, real-time filesystem permissions, OS/kernel isolation, dockerd/kernel trustworthiness, or independence from model training history

the local comparison path, sealed binding path and pre-provisioned external dataset comparison paths remain unproven for stronger physical/network isolation; this observed chain is the prospective authority path only
TraeX budgets are call counts; token and monetary cost cannot be observed
the real prospective chain has been re-observed on the template family here; the broader 3–5 high-frequency task families remain under WP13 acceptance and must not be inferred from this run
